PAHIBALO KALABOT SA TRAFFIC ALANG SA WALK WITH JESUS 2026

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the annual Walk with Jesus 2026. The procession takes place around 3:30 a.m. on Thursday, January 8.

CCTO said motorists should expect temporary slowdowns and intermittent road stoppages along the procession route and adjacent streets.

Northbound motorists are advised to use Magallanes Street or M.C. Briones Street to avoid delays. Southbound motorists may take J. Llorente Street or C. Rodriguez Street.

The office also advised motorists to plan trips and allot extra travel time to avoid delays. | via Lyle Andales #CDNDigital

📷 CCTO

For more news about Cebu and beyond, visit https://t.co/nWCmctdteW.
